//: CommonJS/node-types config for everything the bun composition root doesn't own: tests/ specs + their helpers, and the root config files (playwright.config.ts, drizzle.config.ts, config/environments.ts, users/roles.ts). Predates the bun composition root (server.ts + lib/** + the platform layer db/, auth/, scripts/, and throwaway spike/), which uses bun-only features (bun:sqlite, top-level await, import.meta) and is typechecked by tsconfig.next.json instead — excluded here so this config stays green. `pages/*.ts` is excluded too as of the P2 Environments tab: most page modules are presentation-only (fine under either config), but pages/environments-api.ts is DB-backed platform code (imports db/index.ts -> bun:sqlite) like lib/**, so the WHOLE pages/ dir moved to tsconfig.next.json's include instead of being picked up here by this config's implicit include-everything-not-excluded default. `check:legacy` (the npm script that runs bare `tsc --noEmit` against this config) was never actually about the old interface/ SPA (plain JS, no allowJs — never type-checked by either config) — the P6 cutover that deleted interface/ doesn't touch what this config covers, and it stays live going forward for tests/+config.
